purpose: Prevent source-page labels, press-release language, court orders, and monitor reports from collapsing into one ambiguous status field.

priority_order_for_current_status_candid.note: Governing for consent decree or lawsuit status when applicable.

priority_order_for_current_status_candid.carrier: official monitor report or court-appointed monitor site
priority_order_for_current_status_candid.note: Often more detailed for compliance state, but not a court order.
Useful source-page label, may lag or simplify.
Useful dated event signal; may summarize or frame terminal events.
Can provide context and missing records, but needs source-class weighting.

conflict_rules: Same-owner conflict does not authorize selecting the newer source automatically.
Press-release terminal language creates a reconciliation ticket until the order/docket is frozen.
Closed/dismissed/terminated/retracted language never deletes prior public-record carriers.
Mixed-agency rows require child agency-status objects before department display.
A motion-to-terminate is not a termination.
A source-page “Enforcement” label may be stale, partial, or accurate; do not infer without docket check.
A status candidate may be created under conflict, but public status remains blocked until proof gates close.
